test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: Which of the following is **not** a characteristic of an image formed by a plane mirror?

options.text: The image formed in a plane mirror is virtual and can be received on a screen.
Image is erect and same side up as the object.
Image in a plane mirror is of same size as the object.
The image formed in a plane mirror is laterally inverted.

solution:
The correct answer is option __**1**__

 
• The image formed in a **plane mirror is virtual and cannot be obtained on the screen. **Hence option 1 is wrong.
 
• Characteristics of the image formed by a plane mirror :
 
 
• It is **virtual**.
 
• It is erect and of the **same size** as the object.
 
• The **distance of the object from the plane mirror is the same as the distance of the image** from the plane mirror.
 
• The image is that it is **laterally inverted**.
